title: Remembering my first dream at age 5
content: At around age 5, I had this reoccurring dream where my mom and I were on a 'girls date' at The Mall but there's this weird mythical twist. Any of this sound familiar to y'all? The entrance was this grandiose faux capital building facade, and when you stepped inside the roof was made of clear glass all around (it's always a clear blue sky in my dream). At the center of the mall--where I think the food court typically would be--there's a massive stained glass dome and large multi story terrarium. Around the corner from that is a large IKEA type store which is decked out like the Land of Candy from Charlie & the Chocolate Factory. That's the setting, here's the rest. My mom and 5 year old me go in and are met with this shadow person dressed up as Willy Wonka. He has a very game show host vibe to him, animated, youthful voice and charming personality. We just couldn't see who/or what he was. Long story short, he ended up being a vampire and all the parents sacrificed themselves to him to save the kids. Does the setting or character sound familiar to anyone?
